name: Hasumi Yatohiko
source: Yatohiko is a guy with Kansai dialect and a self-proclaimed “Ogamiya (拝み屋)”. He is good-looking, cheerful and bright young man who talks a lot. Although he can be also too honest at times. Yatohiko is the unrelenting type who roams around Yahiro Gakuen and often appears in front of the protagonist.
